title: Prepaid Label Saving by Merchandise Class on Delivery Claims Found Parcels
content:
Under Delivery Claims, the charge for a found parcel that is kept carries a label saving set by the merchandise class of the line kept.

**Schedule.** The label saving depends on the merchandise class of the line kept: footwear takes 12.00 USD off the charge, apparel 8.00 USD, accessories 6.00 USD, and any other class nothing.

The merchandise class is the one shown on the booking line of the kept line.

| Merchandise class of the line kept | Label saving |
|---|---|
| footwear | 12.00 USD |
| apparel | 8.00 USD |
| accessories | 6.00 USD |
| any other class | none |

The saving is an amount in USD taken off the charge, once per charge, whatever the number of units kept.

*Hypothetical:* a kept pair of trainers (footwear) takes 12.00 USD off the charge; a kept scarf filed under accessories takes 6.00 USD off.
